mapper.select: SELECT rampage_decoration_id, rampage_skill_id, rampage_skill_name, decoration_name, required_slot_size, description FROM rampage_decoration ORDER BY required_slot_size, rampage_decoration_id

SELECT rampage_decoration_id, rampage_skill_id, rampage_skill_name, decoration_name, required_slot_size, description FROM rampage_decoration WHERE required_slot_size = #{requiredSlotSize} ORDER BY rampage_decoration_id

SELECT rampage_decoration_id, rampage_skill_id, rampage_skill_name, decoration_name, required_slot_size, description FROM rampage_decoration WHERE required_slot_size <= #{slotSize} ORDER BY required_slot_size DESC, rampage_decoration_id
SELECT rampage_decoration_id, rampage_skill_id, rampage_skill_name, decoration_name, required_slot_size, description FROM rampage_decoration WHERE rampage_decoration_id = #{rampageDecorationId}
